# hpe_morpheus_datastore (Resource)






<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `associated_resource_id` (Number) The ID of the resource this datastore is associated with, e.g. Cloud, Cluster
- `associated_resource_type` (String) Type of the resource this datastore is associated with, can be 'Cloud' or 'Cluster'
- `datastore_type` (Attributes) The type of datastore. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastore_type))
- `name` (String) The name of the datastore to be created.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `config` (Dynamic) Generic configuration options for the datastore, varies based on the type of datastore.
- `config_alletramp_hvm` (Attributes) AlletraMP HVM Datastore Configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_alletramp_hvm))
- `config_nfs` (Attributes) NFS Cluster Datastore Configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nfs))
- `datastores` (Attributes Set) List of datastores associated with this datastore, for use with vSphere clouds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores))
- `default_store` (Boolean)
- `resource_permissions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_permissions))
- `storage_server` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_server))
- `tenants` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))
- `visibility` (String) Visibility level of the datastore, can be 'private' or 'public'. If not specified, defaults to 'private'.

### Read-Only

- `allow_provision` (Boolean)
- `allow_read` (Boolean)
- `allow_write` (Boolean)
- `cloud` (Attributes) The Cloud this datastore is associated with (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud))
- `code` (String)
- `config_from_api` (Dynamic) Configuration options for the datastore as returned from the API.
- `drs_enabled` (Boolean)
- `execution_id` (String)
- `external_id` (String) UUID for the datastore
- `external_path` (String) External path for the datastore, e.g. mount path, datastore path, etc.
- `external_type` (String) External type for the datastore, e.g. rbd, netfs, dir:gfs2
- `free_space` (Number)
- `heart_beat_target` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `locations` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `online` (Boolean)
- `owner` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `resource_pool` (Attributes) The resource pool this datastore is associated with (for some Cloud datastores) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_pool))
- `status` (String) The current status of the datastore, e.g. 'provisioned', 'provisioning', 'failed', 'warning'
- `status_message` (String) Additional details about the current status of the datastore
- `storage_size` (Number)
- `type` (String) The underlying type of the datastore, e.g. 'generic', 'cluster', 'nfs', 'vmfs', 'NFS Pool', 'Directory Pool', 'GFS2 Pool (Global File System 2)', 'storage-profile', 'ext'
